lines.zh: 红色的我贴着叶子往前。
lines.en: Red, I press along the leaf.
I lift my front half to find the vein.
One short stretch at a time, a steady rhythm.
My back is a glossy red.

lines.zh: 我挪过叶子上的一道褶。
lines.en: I creep over a crease in the leaf.
Belly to the leaf, I push along.

lines.zh: 我沿叶子边缘走，避开洞。
lines.en: I follow the rim, avoiding holes.
Every step needs a firm grip.

lines.zh: 我绕到叶背去，在阴影里。
lines.en: I go under the leaf, into the shade.
The leaf is broad enough for a good walk.

lines.zh: 我在两片叶子之间过去。
lines.en: I pass between two leaves.
Red fuzz brushes the green.
I smell a shoot and quicken.
I come back from the tip.
Halfway, I rest.
My head keeps probing ahead.
I lie there, red as a drop of blood.
I raise my head and hold it.
Half a mouthful of leaf.
The leaf has my holes in it.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，颜色却在说话。
lines.en: Still, but my color does the talking.
Water sounds in the jungle.
Dew has flattened my fuzz.
I arch my body into a half circle.
A butterfly flutters past.
I am at a fork in the vein.
The sun moved; I moved with it.
I must eat a great deal more.

lines.zh: 我这一身红，藏也藏不住。
lines.en: All this red of mine can't hide.
You are walking loudly.
I am in the middle of this leaf.
Keep your hand back.
I eat only leaves.
One reach and the tree shakes.
I look up at you.
Will you crush me?
A bottle would be huge to me.
I would rather stay here.
The pain curls me into a ring.
My red is drawn in.
One segment will not move.
I press to the leaf, gasping.
A patch of fuzz is rubbed off.
A little green fluid leaks.
My mark is on the leaf.
I still grip the vein.
No matter. I keep eating.
Red fluid seeps into the vein.
Tender leaf. I see a tender leaf.
Not the one with holes.
Could you move me over there?
This leaf's edge is dry.

lines.zh: 我吃不了太多，一片就够。
lines.en: I cannot eat much. One leaf is enough.
A leaf dries once it is off.
I smell sweet sap.
Do not tease me with fruit.
There. Yes, that one.
I am not letting go of this leaf.
One touch turns the leaf.
I nearly slid off.

lines.zh: 红的绒毛被你蹭掉一根。
lines.en: You've rubbed off a strand of my red fuzz.
You pinned my tail.

lines.zh: 红色的绒毛沾在你手上。
lines.en: Red fuzz is on your hand now.
I cling hard to the vein.
That is far too much force.
I shift half an inch away.
Do not tug that stem.
I cling to the vein and will not let go.
My wings have not grown in.
Let me finish the chrysalis first.
Many of my kind are in this wood.
I am still only this small.
Not for a caterpillar to consider.
Find one that can fly.
I need to save my strength.
We can talk then.
Do not shake this tree.
My belly is still empty.
I grip a small piece in my jaws.
The ground is soft. I fear going down.
This leaf fragment is still edible.
I drag it along.
Too heavy to hold.
It fell off the leaf.
I pick up a thin stem.
This is not enough.
I chew leaves only; not this.
Put it back on the leaf.
A shadow has fallen.
I rear up my front half to look.
I shrink toward the leaf's edge.
My red cannot hide.
Something is closing in.
Flat to the leaf, my red glistens.

lines.zh: 你的影子从叶尖挪过来。
lines.en: Your shadow slides in from the leaf tip.
There is nowhere else to hide on this leaf.
I hold still where I am.
Move over a little.
I press into the groove of the vein.
The vein is beneath me.
Move, and the leaf rustles.
I flip from top to underside.
I stop on a thin vein.
I watch your fingers.
I have pulled half of me in.
This leaf is already wet.
I wait for a gust.
Do not stir the leaf.
I chew off a piece of leaf.
I butt with my head.
I whip my body once.
This force is nearly nothing.
I only broke the stem.
I spin out a little silk.

lines.zh: 我甩头撞你，只蹭到甲边。
lines.en: I swing my head, grazing your armor edge.
I rear up and sway.
You would not even feel this.
I retreat again.
I poke out of the leaf crease.
A small red piece. That is me.
Light falls from the jungle canopy.
I bit a hole first.
The leaf is heavy with moisture.
I came out of an egg.
This leaf is big enough.
I raise my head to find the vein.
Green everywhere around me.
I begin to crawl forward.
The heat passes, leaving my red scorched.
I slipped off the edge and fell.
Water plasters me to the leaf.
The blast flips the entire leaf.
An arrowhead grazed my back.
This light sets my red aglow.
The leaf dried out. Nothing to eat.
A white flash, and the tree shudders.
No leaf. I fall into the dark.
